obligation: FedRAMP reportability evaluation and default PAIN rating
citation: FedRAMP Consolidated Rules for 2026: IEC-CSO-EFR, IEC-CSO-DPR, IEC-CSO-EFI
trigger: Any incident that may affect the confidentiality or integrity of federal customer data
deadline: Promptly; treat as PAIN-5 unless a PAIN rating is promptly estimated
notify: Internal decision (clock log)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - Government Cloud (Rev5 Class C). Maintaining date 2027-01-01; company standard from 2026-10-01
owner: Federal incident response coordinator (Security Operations Manager)

citation: FedRAMP Consolidated Rules for 2026: IEC-CSO-IIR (Class C)
trigger: FedRAMP Reportable Incident
deadline: Class C: 1 hour for PAIN-3 to PAIN-5; 24 hours for PAIN-2; 1 business day for PAIN-1
notify: FedRAMP (fedramp_security@fedramp.gov); affected agencies by their own procedures; all necessary parties through the trust center
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - Government Cloud. Mandatory from 2027-01-01 (grace ends 2027-06-01); company standard from 2026-10-01

citation: FedRAMP Consolidated Rules for 2026: IEC-CSO-OIR (Class C)
trigger: Open FedRAMP Reportable Incident
deadline: Class C: every 6 hours for PAIN-3 to PAIN-5; 24 hours for PAIN-2; 1 business day for PAIN-1, including updates with no new information
notify: Same parties as the Initial Incident Report
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - Government Cloud

citation: FedRAMP Consolidated Rules for 2026: IEC-CSO-FIR (Class C)
trigger: Incident resolved and recovery complete
deadline: Class C: 6 hours for PAIN-3 to PAIN-5; 1 business day for PAIN-1 and PAIN-2
notify: Same parties as the Initial Incident Report
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - Government Cloud

citation: Agency ATO terms (7 agencies); FedRAMP IEC-CSO-IIR directs providers to follow agency-specific procedures
trigger: Incident affecting an agency's use of the Government Cloud, including availability effects on shared services
deadline: As each agency's ATO terms state (varies by agency; kept in the incident binder)
notify: Each affected agency's designated security contact
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - 7 agencies

obligation: FedRAMP Emergency and Emergency Test messages
citation: FedRAMP Consolidated Rules for 2026: AFC-CSO-CRA, AFC-CSO-EMR
trigger: FedRAMP sends an Emergency or Emergency Test message to the FedRAMP Security Inbox
deadline: Complete the required action within the timeframe in the message; route Emergency messages to the senior security official
notify: FedRAMP, as the message directs
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - in force now (grace ended 2026-07-01)

obligation: DFARS cyber incident report (cloud provider duty by flow-down)
trigger: Cyber incident affecting covered defense information of a defense customer in the Government Cloud
deadline: Rapidly report: within 72 hours of discovery; DoD-approved medium assurance certificate needed to report
notify: DoD through the DIBNet portal, coordinated with the affected defense customer (who reports under its own clause)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - 19 defense customers flow down the clause
owner: Federal incident response coordinator with the Federal Program Director

trigger: Malicious software discovered and isolated in connection with a reported cyber incident
deadline: With the report, as DC3 or the contracting officer instructs
notify: DoD Cyber Crime Center (DC3); not the contracting officer
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - by flow-down

trigger: Cyber incident reported under 252.204-7012(c)
deadline: Preserve images of known affected systems and relevant monitoring and packet capture data for at least 90 days from the report
notify: Held for DoD (DoD may request the media or decline interest)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - by flow-down
clock_starts: Submission of the cyber incident report

obligation: DFARS forensic access and damage assessment
trigger: DoD request after a reported cyber incident
deadline: On request
notify: DoD (through the contracting officer of the defense customer's contract)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - by flow-down

trigger: The company determines a computer-security incident (any occurrence causing actual harm to confidentiality, integrity, or availability, 53.2(b)(4)) has materially disrupted or degraded, or is reasonably likely to, covered services to a bank for 4 or more hours
deadline: As soon as possible after that determination
notify: At least one bank-designated point of contact at each affected bank; if none, the bank's CEO and CIO or two people of comparable responsibility (53.4(a)(1)-(2))
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - 38 banks. Scheduled maintenance previously communicated is excluded (53.4(b)). Each bank must notify its own regulator within 36 hours of its own determination (for example 53.3)
owner: Financial Services Account Director with General Counsel

citation: Master services agreement, security incident clause (contract)
trigger: Confirmed security incident affecting a customer's data or services
deadline: Without undue delay and within 72 hours of confirmation
notify: Each affected customer's security contact
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - all customers; agency terms and the bank addendum add their own terms
owner: Director of NOC and Customer Support with General Counsel

obligation: State breach law: third-party agent notice to customers (Florida worked example)
trigger: Breach of security of personal information the company maintains, stores, or processes for a customer
deadline: As expeditiously as practicable, but no later than 10 days after determining the breach or having reason to believe it occurred
notify: Each affected customer (the covered entity), who then owns notices to individuals and regulators
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - as a third-party agent for customers; each other state where affected individuals reside applies its own law

obligation: State breach law: company as covered entity (Florida worked example)
trigger: Breach of the company's own personal information (employees, customer contacts)
deadline: Individuals no later than 30 days after determination (15-day extension for good cause applies only to this notice); Department of Legal Affairs within 30 days if 500 or more Floridians; consumer reporting agencies if more than 1,000
notify: Affected individuals; Florida Department of Legal Affairs; consumer reporting agencies; other states as their laws require
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - for company-held personal information

obligation: Covered telecommunications equipment or services discovered
trigger: Covered telecommunications equipment or services found in use or delivered under the GSA Schedule contract
deadline: Within 1 business day of identification (further report within 10 business days)
notify: Contracting officer (DoD contracts: https://dibnet.dod.mil)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - GSA Multiple Award Schedule contract

trigger: Kaspersky Lab hardware, software, or services found in use or delivered
deadline: Within 3 business days of identification (further report within 10 business days)
notify: Contracting officer (DoD contracts: https://dibnet.dod.mil)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - GSA Multiple Award Schedule contract

trigger: Covered article subject to a FASCSA order found in use or delivered
deadline: Within 3 business days of identification (further report within 10 business days)
notify: Contracting officer, as the clause directs
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - GSA Multiple Award Schedule contract

obligation: OFAC sanctions check before any ransom payment
citation: OFAC Updated Advisory on Potential Sanctions Risks for Facilitating Ransomware Payments (2021-09-21); 31 CFR ch. V
trigger: Any ransom demand
deadline: Before any payment; full and timely reporting to law enforcement or CISA is a mitigating factor
notify: OFAC (license if a sanctioned party is involved); FBI or CISA
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - all U.S. persons

trigger: Suspected security incident that may lead to a claim; also business interruption from a site loss
deadline: Before engaging incident vendors; through the carrier hotline
notify: Carrier breach hotline; broker
applies_at_this_tier: Yes

obligation: Voluntary report to law enforcement and CISA
trigger: Criminal cyber activity
deadline: As soon as practical (within 2 days as company practice)
notify: FBI (IC3 or field office); CISA
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - voluntary

citation: FedRAMP Consolidated Rules for 2026: CDS-CSO-AVR (Class C)
trigger: Availability incident affecting core services of the Government Cloud
deadline: Web service shows current and 30-day availability, including availability incidents, and stays up even if the offering is down
notify: All necessary parties (agencies, FedRAMP)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - Government Cloud. Maintaining date 2027-08-01 (grace ends 2028-02-01)

obligation: CIRCIA covered cyber incident and ransom payment reports (pending final rule)
trigger: Covered cyber incident or ransom payment (as defined in a final rule)
deadline: Proposed: 72 hours for a covered incident; 24 hours for a ransom payment. Not yet effective
notify: CISA
applies_at_this_tier: No - no final rule as of 2026-09-25; tracked
clock_starts: Not applicable until a final rule takes effect
